caption: A hand reaches across a table toward a lamp, and the shadow of the arm sweeps across the table on the far side of the lamp from the arm.

sa.check: A lamp stands on a table.
A hand reaches across the table toward it.
The shadow of the arm sweeps across the table on the far side of the lamp from the arm.
The arm moves first and the shadow follows.

pc.expect: The arm's shadow lies away from the lamp and moves as the arm moves.
pc.fail: It is cast toward the lamp; or it stays still while the arm moves; or it moves the opposite way.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the arm's outline with the hand at its end.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or the hand is missing from it; or it splits.

pc.expect: The shadow does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It moves with the arm still; or it moves before the arm; or it lingers after the arm is withdrawn.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the table and stretches longer the closer the arm comes to the lamp.
pc.fail: It floats above the table; or it shrinks as the arm nears the lamp; or it is missing with the lamp on.

pc.expect: One lamp, one arm and one shadow; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The hand passes through the lamp; or a second shadow appears; or the shadow becomes solid; or a finger vanishes.

pc.expect: The lamp and the table stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The lamp changes; or the shadow turns coloured; or the table changes.

note: The arm is the object casting the shadow; the person is not judged.
